text:
sara (Finance): Heads-up: starting 2026-05-01 we'll move hosted usage invoicing to a rolling daily cutover (00:00 UTC) and change how remaining free credits are carried forward. Goal is clearer daily visibility and fewer end-of-month surprises for customers.

sara (Finance): TL;DR bullets:
- Hosted metered invoices will be generated on a daily aggregation window at 00:00 UTC instead of a single end-of-month batch.
- Any remaining free credits at the time of migration will be converted into a `carry_forward_free_credit` line item and prorated across the new daily windows.
- The temporary soft-grace buffer that postponed overage charges is being sunsetted; active customers will be billed for usage above credits at published rates.
- Reserved/Dedicated committed plans are unchanged (billing cadence remains monthly/annual).

leo (Billing): Quick clarifier: what about customers with usage that spikes exactly at cutover (e.g., heavy traffic at 23:59 UTC)? Will we risk double-counting if requests straddle windows?

anna -> anna (typo)

anna (Eng): tagging infra/telemetry — we will ensure the metering daemon stamps requests with the billing-window header `X-Billing-Window` and deduplicates on UUID at cutover. Need a test matrix.

leo (Billing): Nice. Can we add the `billing-run-id` to invoices so AMs can match events to raw logs?

sara (Finance): Yes, invoices will include `billing-run-id` and `window_start/window_end` meta fields. Will update the sample invoice in docs.

iris (Revenue Ops): Customer comms plan? AMs will need scripts for explaining why daily lines now appear and how unused credits are shown.

sara (Finance): Draft customer email will go out next week. Key points: no customer action needed; credits are preserved (visibly as carry-forward); overage charging resumes per normal pricing; contact AM/Support for exceptions. Iris please coordinate.

leo (Billing): One more: refunds for customers who recently paid for monthly credits — are we offering any transition refunds or account-level credits?

sara (Finance): We will not auto-refund past payments. Instead, for qualifying customers we can issue account credits equivalent to unused portion upon request. AMs can escalate to billing for case-by-case holds. We'll publish the eligibility matrix.

anna (Eng): FYI the routing fallback can currently mirror request logs to both primary and fallback during overloads. We'll disable mirrored metering during the 48h migration window to avoid double billing.

billing-bot: migration_ticket_2301112222 created -> status: scheduled, ETA: 48h. Will post progress updates. :gear:

leo (Billing): I'll prepare a short FAQ for customers (Q: Why did my invoice change? A: Daily aggregation + visible carry-forward credits). Will share draft by Thu.

sara (Finance): Example proration we will show in docs (different form):
```
carry_forward = floor((unused_credit_amount / days_left) * remaining_days)
# e.g. unused_credit_amount=$150, days_left=15 => per-day allocation $10 -> shown as $150 carry_forward
```

sara (Finance): Rollout checklist (owners):
- Finance: publish final docs & sample invoices (due 2026-04-15).
- Billing: add `billing-run-id` to CSV/JSON invoice exports + FAQ (due 2026-04-12).
- Eng: disable mirrored-metering and run cutover testcases (due 2026-04-13).
- Support/AMs: finalize canned responses & escalation playbook (due 2026-04-14).
- Revenue Ops: customer comms schedule and AM training (due 2026-04-16).

sara (Finance): Risks to watch: delayed invoice generation if daily job hits backpressure, telemetry gaps during migration, and mis-tagged reserved plans. Please flag any blockers ASAP.

anna (Eng): We'll run an end-to-end in staging with synthetic traffic and confirm invoices match expected usage lines. Posting results here when done.

leo (Billing): Thanks all. I'll post the initial customer-facing FAQ draft shortly.

sara (Finance): Office hours tomorrow 15:00 UTC in #announcements-office-hours for anyone who wants to walk through the invoice samples. Thanks! :seedling:
